If density of material of the sphere is $1.4\text{ g/cm}^3$, the dielectric constant of the liquid is _________ ($\tan 37^\circ = \frac{3}{4}$)

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A simple pendulum is placed at a place where its distance from the earth’s surface is equal to the radius of the earth. If the length of the string is 4m, then the time period of small oscillations will be _______ s. [take $g = \pi^2\text{ ms}^{-2}$]

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A point source is emitting sound waves of intensity $16 \times 10^{-8}\text{ Wm}^{-2}$ at the origin. The difference in intensity (magnitude only) at two points located at a distances of 2m and 4m from the origin respectively will be _______ $\times 10^{-8}\text{ Wm}^{-2}$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: Two resistance of $100\Omega$ and $200\Omega$ are connected in series with a battery of 4 V and negligible internal resistance. A voltmeter is used to measure voltage across $100\Omega$ resistance, which gives reading as 1 V. The resistance of voltmeter must be ______ $\Omega$.
